   284→      taskType: segmentType,
   285→      projectId,
   286→      select: "id, status, generation_started_at",
   287→      runId: orchestratorRunId,
   288→      contextLabel: 'OrchestratorComplete',
   289→    });
   290→    if (runIdRows.length > 0) {
   291→      return runIdRows;
   292→    }
   293→  }
   294→  const orchestratorRows = await lookupTasksByOrchestratorIdWithFallback<SegmentTask>({
   295→    supabase,
   296→    taskType: segmentType,
   297→    projectId,
   298→    select: "id, status, generation_started_at",
   299→    orchestratorTaskId,
   300→    contextLabel: 'OrchestratorComplete',
   301→  });
   302→  return orchestratorRows;
   303→}
   304→/**
   305→ * Check the status of the final stitch task for this orchestrator
   306→ */
   307→async function checkFinalStitchStatus(
   308→  supabase: SupabaseClient,
   309→  finalStepType: string,
   310→  projectId: string,
   311→  orchestratorTaskId: string,
   312→  orchestratorRunId: string | null,
   313→): Promise<'not_found' | 'pending' | 'complete' | 'failed' | 'unknown'> {
   314→  let finalStepTasks: Array<{ id: string; status: string }> = [];
   315→  if (orchestratorRunId) {
   316→    finalStepTasks = await lookupTasksByRunIdWithFallback<{ id: string; status: string }>({
   317→      supabase,
   318→      taskType: finalStepType,
   319→      projectId,
   320→      select: "id, status",
   321→      runId: orchestratorRunId,
   322→      contextLabel: 'OrchestratorComplete',
   323→    });
   324→  }
   325→  if (finalStepTasks.length === 0) {
   326→    finalStepTasks = await lookupTasksByOrchestratorIdWithFallback<{ id: string; status: string }>({
   327→      supabase,
   328→      taskType: finalStepType,
   329→      projectId,
   330→      select: "id, status",
   331→      orchestratorTaskId,
   332→      contextLabel: 'OrchestratorComplete',
   333→    });
   334→  }
   335→  if (!finalStepTasks || finalStepTasks.length === 0) {
   336→    return 'not_found';
   337→  }
   338→  if (finalStepTasks.some((task) => isFailureStatus(task.status))) {
   339→    return 'failed';
   340→  }
   341→  if (finalStepTasks.some((task) => task.status === 'Complete')) {
   342→    return 'complete';
   343→  }
   344→  if (finalStepTasks.some((task) => task.status === 'Queued' || task.status === 'In Progress')) {
   345→    return 'pending';
   346→  }
   347→  return 'unknown';
   348→}
   349→/**
   350→ * Mark orchestrator as Failed
   351→ */
   352→async function markOrchestratorFailed(
   353→  supabase: SupabaseClient,
   354→  orchestratorTaskId: string,
   355→  failedSegments: number,
   356→  totalSegments: number,
   357→  errorMessage?: string,
   358→  logger?: {
   359→    warn: (message: string, context?: Record<string, unknown>) => void;
   360→    error: (message: string, context?: Record<string, unknown>) => void;
   361→  },
   362→): Promise<void> {
   363→  const { data: updatedRows, error: updateOrchError } = await supabase
   364→    .from("tasks")
   365→    .update({
   366→      status: "Failed",
   367→      error_message: errorMessage ?? `${failedSegments} of ${totalSegments} segments failed`,
   368→      generation_processed_at: new Date().toISOString()
   369→    })
   370→    .eq("id", orchestratorTaskId)
   371→    .in("status", ["Queued", "In Progress"])
   372→    .select('id');
   373→  if (updateOrchError) {
   374→    throw new CompletionError({
   375→      code: 'orchestrator_mark_failed_update_failed',
   376→      context: 'markOrchestratorFailed',
   377→      recoverable: true,
   378→      message: `[OrchestratorComplete] Failed to mark orchestrator ${orchestratorTaskId} as Failed`,
   379→      metadata: {
   380→        orchestrator_task_id: orchestratorTaskId,
   381→        update_error: updateOrchError instanceof Error
   382→          ? updateOrchError.message
   383→          : String(updateOrchError),
   384→      },
   385→      cause: updateOrchError,
   386→    });
   387→  }
   388→  const transitionedRows = (updatedRows ?? []) as TaskUpdateRow[];
   389→  if (transitionedRows.length === 0) {
   390→    logger?.warn('Orchestrator already terminal while marking failed', {
   391→      orchestrator_task_id: orchestratorTaskId,
   392→      failed_segments: failedSegments,
   393→      total_segments: totalSegments,
   394→    });
   395→  }
   396→}
   397→/**
   398→ * Mark orchestrator as Complete and trigger billing
   399→ */
   400→async function markOrchestratorComplete(
   401→  params: {
   402→    supabase: SupabaseClient;
   403→    orchestratorTask: OrchestratorTask;
   404→    orchestratorTaskId: string;
   405→    allSegments: SegmentTask[];
   406→    publicUrl: string;
   407→    isFinalStep: boolean;
   408→    supabaseUrl: string;
   409→    serviceKey: string;
   410→    logger?: {
   411→      warn: (message: string, context?: Record<string, unknown>) => void;
   412→      error: (message: string, context?: Record<string, unknown>) => void;
   413→    };
   414→  },
   415→): Promise<void> {
   416→  const {
   417→    supabase,
   418→    orchestratorTask,
   419→    orchestratorTaskId,
   420→    allSegments,
   421→    publicUrl,
   422→    isFinalStep,
   423→    supabaseUrl,
   424→    serviceKey,
   425→    logger,
   426→  } = params;
   427→  let earliestStartTime: string | null = null;
   428→  for (const segment of allSegments) {
   429→    if (segment.generation_started_at) {
   430→      if (!earliestStartTime || segment.generation_started_at < earliestStartTime) {
   431→        earliestStartTime = segment.generation_started_at;
   432→      }
   433→    }
   434→  }
   435→  const updateData: Record<string, unknown> = {
   436→    status: "Complete",
   437→    generation_started_at: earliestStartTime || new Date().toISOString(),
   438→    generation_processed_at: new Date().toISOString()
   439→  };
   440→  if (isFinalStep) {
   441→    updateData.output_location = publicUrl;
   442→  }
   443→  const { data: updatedRows, error: updateOrchError } = await supabase
   444→    .from("tasks")
   445→    .update(updateData)
   446→    .eq("id", orchestratorTaskId)
   447→    .in("status", ["Queued", "In Progress"])
   448→    .select('id');
   449→  if (updateOrchError) {
   450→    throw new CompletionError({
   451→      code: 'orchestrator_mark_complete_update_failed',
   452→      context: 'markOrchestratorComplete',
   453→      recoverable: true,
   454→      message: `[OrchestratorComplete] Failed to mark orchestrator ${orchestratorTaskId} as Complete`,
   455→      metadata: {
   456→        orchestrator_task_id: orchestratorTaskId,
   457→        update_error: updateOrchError instanceof Error
   458→          ? updateOrchError.message
   459→          : String(updateOrchError),
   460→      },
   461→      cause: updateOrchError,
   462→    });
   463→  }
   464→  const transitionedRows = (updatedRows ?? []) as TaskUpdateRow[];
   465→  if (transitionedRows.length === 0) {
   466→    logger?.warn('Orchestrator already in terminal status; skipping billing side effects', {
   467→      orchestrator_task_id: orchestratorTaskId,
   468→    });
   469→    return;
   470→  }
   471→  const billingResult = await triggerCostCalculation({
   472→    supabaseUrl,
   473→    serviceKey,
   474→    taskId: orchestratorTaskId,
   475→    logTag: 'OrchestratorComplete',
   476→  });
   477→  const existingResultData = asObjectOrEmpty(orchestratorTask.result_data);
   478→  const billingDecision = classifyBillingOutcome(billingResult);
   479→  const billingOutcome = buildBillingOutcome(billingResult, billingDecision);
   480→  await persistBillingOutcome(
   481→    supabase,
   482→    orchestratorTaskId,
   483→    existingResultData,
   484→    billingOutcome,
   485→    billingDecision,
   486→    logger,
   487→  );
   488→  if (billingDecision.reconciliationRequired) {
   489→    logger?.warn('Billing requires reconciliation policy follow-up', {
   490→      orchestrator_task_id: orchestratorTaskId,
   491→      billing_decision: billingDecision,
   492→      billing_result: billingResult,
   493→    });
   494→  }
   495→}
   496→

     8→ * to image-URL lookup if the explicit ID is missing or stale.

    10→export async function resolveBasedOn(
    11→  supabase: SupabaseClient,
    12→  params: unknown,
    13→): Promise<string | null> {
    14→  const record = params && typeof params === 'object' && !Array.isArray(params)
    15→    ? params as Record<string, unknown>
    16→    : {};
    17→
    18→  let basedOnGenerationId: string | null = extractBasedOn(record);
    19→
    20→  if (basedOnGenerationId) {
    21→    const { data: basedOnGen, error: basedOnError } = await supabase
    22→      .from('generations')
    23→      .select('id')
    24→      .eq('id', basedOnGenerationId)
    25→      .maybeSingle();
    26→
    27→    if (basedOnError || !basedOnGen) {
    28→      basedOnGenerationId = null;
    29→    }
    30→  }
    31→
    32→  if (!basedOnGenerationId) {
    33→    const sourceImageUrl = typeof record.image === 'string' && record.image.length > 0
    34→      ? record.image
    35→      : null;
    36→    if (sourceImageUrl) {
    37→      basedOnGenerationId = await findSourceGenerationByImageUrl(supabase, sourceImageUrl);
    38→    }
    39→  }
    40→
    41→  return basedOnGenerationId;
    42→}

    47→export function buildGenerationParams(

    53→  sourceTaskId?: string
    54→): unknown {

    59→

    62→  // to distinguish task-created generations (which should show NEW badge)
    63→  // from manual uploads (which should be auto-marked as viewed)
    64→  if (sourceTaskId) {
    65→    generationParams.source_task_id = sourceTaskId;
    66→  }
    67→

    69→  if (contentType) {

    16→export type CompletionFollowUpStep =

    22→export interface CompletionFollowUpIssue {

    27→
    28→function defaultErrorCode(status: number): string {
    29→  if (status === 401) return 'authentication_failed';
    30→  if (status === 403) return 'forbidden';
    31→  if (status === 404) return 'not_found';
    32→  if (status === 405) return 'method_not_allowed';
    33→  if (status === 429) return 'rate_limited';
    34→  if (status === 503) return 'service_unavailable';
    35→  if (status >= 500) return 'internal_server_error';
    36→  return 'request_failed';
    37→}
    38→
    39→export function completeTaskErrorResponse(
    40→  message: string,
    41→  status: number,
    42→  errorCode = defaultErrorCode(status),
    43→): Response {
    44→  return edgeErrorResponse(
    45→    {
    46→      errorCode,
    47→      message,
    48→      recoverable: status >= 500 || status === 429,
    49→    },
    50→    status,
    51→  );
    52→}
    53→
    54→function asObjectRecord(value: unknown): Record<string, unknown> {
    55→  if (!value || typeof value !== 'object' || Array.isArray(value)) {
    56→    return {};
    57→  }
    58→  return value as Record<string, unknown>;
    59→}
    60→
    61→/**
    62→ * Best-effort mark a task as Failed so the UI can update immediately.
    63→ * Swallows errors — callers still return their own HTTP error response.
    64→ */
    65→export async function markTaskFailed(
    66→  supabase: SupabaseClient,
    67→  taskId: string,
    68→  errorMessage: string,
    69→): Promise<void> {
    70→  try {
    71→    await supabase.from("tasks").update({
    72→      status: "Failed",
    73→      error_message: errorMessage,
    74→      updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
    75→    }).eq("id", taskId).in("status", ["Queued", "In Progress"]);
    76→  } catch {
    77→    // Best-effort — don't mask the original error
    78→  }
    79→}
    80→
    81→export async function persistCompletionFollowUpIssues(
    82→  supabase: SupabaseClient,
    83→  taskId: string,
    84→  existingResultData: unknown,
    85→  issues: CompletionFollowUpIssue[],
    86→): Promise<{ ok: true } | { ok: false; error: unknown }> {
    87→  if (issues.length === 0) {
    88→    return { ok: true };
    89→  }
    90→
    91→  const baseResultData = asObjectRecord(existingResultData);
    92→  const completionFollowUp = {
    93→    status: 'degraded',
    94→    recorded_at: new Date().toISOString(),
    95→    issues,
    96→  };
    97→
    98→  const { error } = await supabase
    99→    .from('tasks')
   100→    .update({
   101→      result_data: {
   102→        ...baseResultData,
   103→        completion_follow_up: completionFollowUp,
   104→      },
   105→    })
   106→    .eq('id', taskId);
   107→
   108→  if (error) {
   109→    return { ok: false, error };
   110→  }
   111→
   112→  return { ok: true };
   113→}

   117→ * Uses a single query with FK join (tasks.task_type -> task_types.name).

   120→export async function fetchTaskContext(

   130→    .eq("id", taskId)

   132→
   133→  if (error || !task) {

   138→    return null;
   139→  }

   142→
   143→  return {

   145→    task_type: task.task_type,
   146→    project_id: task.project_id,
   147→    params: task.params || {},
   148→    result_data: task.result_data,

    36→type TaskParseResult =

    40→function asNumber(value: unknown): number | undefined {
    41→  return typeof value === 'number' && Number.isFinite(value) ? value : undefined;

    43→
    44→export function parseTaskCostParams(value: unknown): TaskCostParams {
    45→  const record = asObjectRecord(value) ?? {};
    46→  const parsed: TaskCostParams = {};
    47→
    48→  const resolution = asString(record.resolution);
    49→  if (resolution) {
    50→    parsed.resolution = resolution;
    51→  }
    52→
    53→  const frameCount = asNumber(record.frame_count);
    54→  if (frameCount !== undefined) {
    55→    parsed.frame_count = frameCount;
    56→  }
    57→
    58→  const modelType = asString(record.model_type);
    59→  if (modelType) {
    60→    parsed.model_type = modelType;
    61→  }
    62→
    63→  const result = asObjectRecord(record.result);
    64→  if (result) {
    65→    parsed.result = result as VideoEnhanceResult;
    66→  }
    67→
    68→  for (const [key, rawValue] of Object.entries(record)) {

    70→    if (key === 'resolution' || key === 'frame_count' || key === 'model_type' || key === 'result') {

    72→    }
    73→    parsed[key] = rawValue;
    74→  }

    76→  return parsed;

    79→export function parseTaskWithProject(value: unknown): TaskParseResult {
    80→  const task = asObjectRecord(value);

   113→  const userId = asString(projectRecord?.user_id);

   166→export function jsonResponse(body: unknown, status = 200) {

   191→  );
   192→}

   194→// Pricing constants for video_enhance task (fal.ai rates)
   195→const VIDEO_ENHANCE_PRICING = {
   196→  // FILM (interpolation): $0.0013 per compute second
   197→  FILM_COST_PER_SECOND: 0.0013,
   198→  // FlashVSR (upscale): $0.0005 per megapixel (width × height × frames / 1,000,000)
   199→  FLASHVSR_COST_PER_MEGAPIXEL: 0.0005,
   200→};
   201→
   202→interface VideoEnhanceResult {
   203→  interpolation_compute_seconds?: number;
   204→  output_width?: number;
   205→  output_height?: number;
   206→  output_frames?: number;
   207→  result?: VideoEnhanceResult;
   208→}
   209→
   210→interface VideoEnhanceBreakdown {
   211→  interpolation?: { compute_seconds: number; cost_per_second: number; cost: number };
   212→  upscale?: { output_width: number; output_height: number; output_frames: number; megapixels: number; cost_per_megapixel: number; cost: number };
   213→}
   214→
   215→// Special cost calculation for video_enhance task
   216→// Combines FILM (time-based) and FlashVSR (megapixel-based) pricing
   217→function calculateVideoEnhanceCost(taskParams: VideoEnhanceResult): { cost: number; breakdown: VideoEnhanceBreakdown } {
   218→  let totalCost = 0;
   219→  const breakdown: VideoEnhanceBreakdown = {};
   220→
   221→  // Get result data from task params (worker should populate this)
   222→  const result = taskParams?.result || taskParams;
   223→
   224→  // FILM interpolation cost: $0.0013 per compute second
   225→  if (result?.interpolation_compute_seconds && result.interpolation_compute_seconds > 0) {
   226→    const filmCost = VIDEO_ENHANCE_PRICING.FILM_COST_PER_SECOND * result.interpolation_compute_seconds;
   227→    totalCost += filmCost;
   228→    breakdown.interpolation = {
   229→      compute_seconds: result.interpolation_compute_seconds,
   230→      cost_per_second: VIDEO_ENHANCE_PRICING.FILM_COST_PER_SECOND,
   231→      cost: Math.round(filmCost * 1000000) / 1000000,
   232→    };
   233→  }
   234→
   235→  // FlashVSR upscale cost: $0.0005 per megapixel
   236→  if (result?.output_width && result?.output_height && result?.output_frames) {
   237→    const megapixels = (result.output_width * result.output_height * result.output_frames) / 1_000_000;
   238→    const upscaleCost = VIDEO_ENHANCE_PRICING.FLASHVSR_COST_PER_MEGAPIXEL * megapixels;
   239→    totalCost += upscaleCost;
   240→    breakdown.upscale = {
   241→      output_width: result.output_width,
   242→      output_height: result.output_height,
   243→      output_frames: result.output_frames,
   244→      megapixels: Math.round(megapixels * 100) / 100,
   245→      cost_per_megapixel: VIDEO_ENHANCE_PRICING.FLASHVSR_COST_PER_MEGAPIXEL,
   246→      cost: Math.round(upscaleCost * 1000000) / 1000000,
   247→    };
   248→  }
   249→
   250→  return {
   251→    cost: Math.round(totalCost * 1000000) / 1000000,
   252→    breakdown,
   253→  };
   254→}
   255→
   256→interface CostFactors {
   257→  resolution?: Record<string, number>;
   258→  frameCount?: number;
   259→  modelType?: Record<string, number>;
   260→}
   261→
   262→interface TaskCostParams {
   263→  resolution?: string;
   264→  frame_count?: number;
   265→  model_type?: string;
   266→  result?: VideoEnhanceResult;
   267→  [key: string]: unknown;
   268→}
   269→
   270→// Calculate cost based on billing type and task configuration
   271→export function calculateTaskCost(
   272→  taskType: string,
   273→  billingType: string,
   274→  baseCostPerSecond: number,
   275→  unitCost: number,
   276→  durationSeconds: number,
   277→  costFactors: CostFactors | null,
   278→  taskParams: TaskCostParams
   279→): { cost: number; breakdown?: VideoEnhanceBreakdown } {
   280→  // Special case: video_enhance has compound pricing (FILM + FlashVSR)
   281→  if (taskType === 'video_enhance') {
   282→    return calculateVideoEnhanceCost(taskParams);
   283→  }
   284→
   285→  let totalCost;
   286→  if (billingType === 'per_unit') {
   287→    totalCost = unitCost || 0;
   288→  } else {
   289→    totalCost = baseCostPerSecond * durationSeconds;
   290→  }
   291→
   292→  // Apply cost factors regardless of billing type
   293→  if (costFactors) {
   294→    if (costFactors.resolution && taskParams.resolution) {
   295→      const resolutionMultiplier = costFactors.resolution[taskParams.resolution] || 1;
   296→      totalCost *= resolutionMultiplier;
   297→    }
   298→    if (costFactors.frameCount && taskParams.frame_count) {
   299→      if (billingType === 'per_unit') {
   300→        totalCost += costFactors.frameCount * taskParams.frame_count;
   301→      } else {
   302→        totalCost += costFactors.frameCount * taskParams.frame_count * durationSeconds;
   303→      }
   304→    }
   305→    if (costFactors.modelType && taskParams.model_type) {
   306→      const modelMultiplier = costFactors.modelType[taskParams.model_type] || 1;
   307→      totalCost *= modelMultiplier;
   308→    }
   309→  }
   310→
   311→  return { cost: Math.round(totalCost * 1000) / 1000 };
   312→}
   313→

1→/**
     2→ * Calculate placement for a new structure video on the timeline.
     3→ * Places after the last existing video, clipping the last video if needed to make space.
     4→ *
     5→ * @returns Object with start_frame, end_frame, and optional lastVideoUpdate if clipping is needed
     6→ */
     7→interface VideoPlacementResult {
     8→  start_frame: number;
     9→  end_frame: number;
    10→  lastVideoUpdate?: { index: number; newEndFrame: number };
    11→}
    12→
    13→export const calculateNewVideoPlacement = (
    14→  videoFrameCount: number,
    15→  existingVideos: Array<{ path: string; start_frame: number; end_frame: number }> | undefined,
    16→  fullMax: number
    17→): VideoPlacementResult => {
    18→  let start_frame = 0;
    19→  let end_frame = videoFrameCount;
    20→  let lastVideoUpdate: { index: number; newEndFrame: number } | undefined;
    21→
    22→  if (existingVideos && existingVideos.length > 0) {
    23→    const sorted = [...existingVideos].sort((a, b) => a.start_frame - b.start_frame);
    24→    const lastVideo = sorted[sorted.length - 1];
    25→    const lastVideoIndex = existingVideos.findIndex(
    26→      v => v.path === lastVideo.path && v.start_frame === lastVideo.start_frame
    27→    );
    28→
    29→    start_frame = lastVideo.end_frame;
    30→    end_frame = start_frame + videoFrameCount;
    31→
    32→    // If no space on timeline, clip 1/5 of the last video's range
    33→    if (start_frame >= fullMax && lastVideoIndex >= 0) {
    34→      const lastVideoRange = lastVideo.end_frame - lastVideo.start_frame;
    35→      const clipAmount = Math.max(10, Math.floor(lastVideoRange / 5));
    36→      const newLastVideoEnd = lastVideo.end_frame - clipAmount;
    37→
    38→      if (newLastVideoEnd > lastVideo.start_frame + 10) {
    39→        lastVideoUpdate = { index: lastVideoIndex, newEndFrame: newLastVideoEnd };
    40→        start_frame = newLastVideoEnd;
    41→        end_frame = start_frame + videoFrameCount;
    42→      }
    43→    }
    44→  }
    45→
    46→  return { start_frame, end_frame, lastVideoUpdate };
    47→};
    48→
    49→/**
    50→ * Extract pair_shot_generation_id from a generation row.
    51→ * Checks the FK column first, then falls back to params for legacy data.
    52→ */
    53→const getPairShotGenerationId = (
    54→  generation: {
    55→    pair_shot_generation_id?: string | null;
    56→    params?: Record<string, unknown> | null;
    57→  }
    58→): string | null => {
    59→  // Check FK column first (new format)
    60→  if (generation.pair_shot_generation_id) {
    61→    return generation.pair_shot_generation_id;
    62→  }
    63→
    64→  // Fallback to params (legacy format)
    65→  const params = generation.params;
    66→  if (!params) return null;
    67→
    68→  const individualParams = params.individual_segment_params as Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
    69→  return (
    70→    (individualParams?.pair_shot_generation_id as string) ||
    71→    (params.pair_shot_generation_id as string) ||
    72→    null
    73→  );
    74→};
    75→
    76→/**
    77→ * Find trailing video info from a list of video outputs.
    78→ * A trailing video is one where pair_shot_generation_id matches the last image's shot_generation_id.
    79→ *
    80→ * @param videoOutputs - Array of generation rows (video outputs)
    81→ * @param lastImageShotGenId - The shot_generation_id of the last image on the timeline
    82→ * @returns Object with hasTrailing boolean and optional videoUrl
    83→ */
    84→export const findTrailingVideoInfo = (
    85→  videoOutputs: Array<{
    86→    type?: string | null;
    87→    location?: string | null;
    88→    pair_shot_generation_id?: string | null;
    89→    params?: Record<string, unknown> | null;
    90→  }>,
    91→  lastImageShotGenId: string | null
    92→): { hasTrailing: boolean; videoUrl: string | null } => {
    93→  if (!videoOutputs || videoOutputs.length === 0 || !lastImageShotGenId) {
    94→    return { hasTrailing: false, videoUrl: null };
    95→  }
    96→
    97→  const trailingVideo = videoOutputs.find(gen => {
    98→    // Must be a video with a location (completed)
    99→    if (!gen.type?.includes('video') || !gen.location) return false;
   100→    // Check if pair_shot_generation_id matches the last image
   101→    const pairId = getPairShotGenerationId(gen);
   102→    return pairId === lastImageShotGenId;
   103→  });
   104→
   105→  return {
   106→    hasTrailing: !!trailingVideo,
   107→    videoUrl: trailingVideo?.location || null,
   108→  };
   109→};

     3→import { TIMELINE_PADDING_OFFSET } from './constants';
     4→import { getAspectRatioStyle as getProjectAspectRatioStyle } from '@/shared/components/ShotImageManager/utils/image-utils';
     5→
     6→interface TimelineItemPositionInput {
     7→  timelineWidth: number;
     8→  fullMinFrames: number;
     9→  fullRange: number;
    10→  framePosition: number;
    11→  isDragging: boolean;
    12→  dragOffset: { x: number; y: number } | null;

    16→
    17→export function getTimelineItemAspectRatioStyle(
    18→  image: GenerationRow,
    19→  projectAspectRatio?: string,
    20→): CSSProperties {
    21→  let width = image.metadata?.width as number | undefined;
    22→  let height = image.metadata?.height as number | undefined;
    23→
    24→  if (!width || !height) {
    25→    const originalParams = image.metadata?.originalParams as Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
    26→    const orchestratorDetails = originalParams?.orchestrator_details as Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
    27→    const resolution = orchestratorDetails?.resolution as string | undefined;
    28→    if (resolution && resolution.includes('x')) {
    29→      const [w, h] = resolution.split('x').map(Number);
    30→      if (!Number.isNaN(w) && !Number.isNaN(h)) {
    31→        width = w;
    32→        height = h;
    33→      }
    34→    }
    35→  }
    36→
    37→  if (width && height) {
    38→    return { aspectRatio: `${width / height}` };
    39→  }
    40→
    41→  return getProjectAspectRatioStyle(projectAspectRatio);
    42→}
    43→
    44→export function getTimelineItemPosition({
    45→  timelineWidth,
    46→  fullMinFrames,
    47→  fullRange,
    48→  framePosition,
    49→  isDragging,
    50→  dragOffset,
    51→  originalFramePos,
    52→  currentDragFrame,
    53→}: TimelineItemPositionInput): { leftPercent: number; displayFrame: number } {
    54→  const effectiveWidth = timelineWidth - (TIMELINE_PADDING_OFFSET * 2);
    55→  const pixelPosition = TIMELINE_PADDING_OFFSET + ((framePosition - fullMinFrames) / fullRange) * effectiveWidth;
    56→
    57→  let finalX = pixelPosition;
    58→  if (isDragging && dragOffset) {
    59→    const originalPixel = TIMELINE_PADDING_OFFSET + ((originalFramePos - fullMinFrames) / fullRange) * effectiveWidth;
    60→    finalX = originalPixel + dragOffset.x;
    61→  }
    62→
    63→  const displayFrame = isDragging && currentDragFrame !== null ? currentDragFrame : framePosition;
    64→  const leftPercent = (finalX / timelineWidth) * 100;
    65→
    66→  return { leftPercent, displayFrame };
    67→}
    68→

   131→      skipOptimistic && snapshotRef.current ? snapshotRef.current : positionsRef.current;
   132→    const changes = detectPositionChanges(basePositions, quantizedPositions);
   133→
   134→    const trailingRemoved = positionsRef.current.has(TRAILING_ENDPOINT_KEY) && !quantizedPositions.has(TRAILING_ENDPOINT_KEY);
   135→
   136→    if (changes.length === 0 && !trailingRemoved) {
   137→      return;
   138→    }
   139→
   140→    if (hasDuplicatePositionValues(quantizedPositions)) {
   141→      toast.error('Position conflict detected - operation cancelled');
   142→      return;
   143→    }
   144→
   145→    let rollback: (() => void) | null = null;
   146→    if (!skipOptimistic) {
   147→      const optimisticUpdates = changes.map(c => ({
   148→        id: c.id,
   149→        position: c.newPos,
   150→        operation: (c.oldPos === null ? 'add' : 'move') as 'add' | 'move' | 'remove',
   151→      }));
   152→      if (trailingRemoved) {
   153→        optimisticUpdates.push({
   154→          id: TRAILING_ENDPOINT_KEY,
   155→          position: 0,
   156→          operation: 'remove',
   157→        });
   158→      }

   160→    } else if (externalRollback !== undefined) {
   161→      rollback = externalRollback;
   162→    }
   163→
   164→    if (skipDatabase) {
   165→      clearPendingUpdates(changes.map(c => c.id));
   166→      return;
   167→    }

   169→    writeInFlightRef.current++;
   170→
   171→    isUpdatingRef.current = true;
   172→    setStatus({
   173→      type: 'updating',
   174→      operationId,
   175→      description: `${operation}: ${changes.length} items`,
   176→    });
   177→
   178→    isLockedRef.current = true;
   179→
   180→    try {
   181→      const trailingChange = changes.find(c => c.id === TRAILING_ENDPOINT_KEY);
   182→      const imageChanges = changes.filter(c => c.id !== TRAILING_ENDPOINT_KEY);
   183→
   184→      const dbUpdates: Array<{ shot_generation_id: string; timeline_frame: number }> = [];
   185→      for (const change of imageChanges) {
   186→        const shotGen = shotGenerations.find(sg => sg.id === change.id);
   187→        if (shotGen) {
   188→          dbUpdates.push({
   189→            shot_generation_id: shotGen.id,
   190→            timeline_frame: change.newPos,
   191→          });
   192→        }
   193→      }
   194→
   195→      if (trailingChange) {
   196→        await setTrailingEndpointFrame(
   197→          {
   198→            shotId,
   199→            operationId,
   200→            shotGenerations,
   201→            logPrefix: '',
   202→            log: () => {},
   203→            signal,
   204→          },
   205→          trailingChange.newPos,
   206→        );
   207→      }
   208→
   209→      if (trailingRemoved) {
   210→        await clearTrailingEndpointFrame({
   211→          shotId,
   212→          operationId,
   213→          shotGenerations,
   214→          logPrefix: '',
   215→          log: () => {},
   216→          signal,
   217→        });
   218→      }
   219→
   220→      if (dbUpdates.length === 0 && !trailingChange && !trailingRemoved) {
   221→        clearPendingUpdates(changes.map(c => c.id));
   222→        return;
   223→      }
   224→
   225→      if (dbUpdates.length > 0) {
   226→        await persistTimelineFrameBatch({
   227→          shotId,
   228→          updates: dbUpdates.map((update) => ({
   229→            shotGenerationId: update.shot_generation_id,
   230→            timelineFrame: update.timeline_frame,
   231→            metadata: {
   232→              user_positioned: true,
   233→              drag_source: operation,
   234→              ...metadata,
   235→            },
   236→          })),
   237→          operationLabel: `timeline-positions-${operation}`,
   238→          timeoutOperationName: 'timeline-positions-batch-rpc',
   239→          signal,
   240→          logPrefix: '',
   241→          log: () => {},
   242→        });

   245→      invalidateGenerations(shotId, {
   246→        reason: 'timeline-position-batch-persist',
   247→        scope: 'images',
   248→        delayMs: 100,
   249→      });
   250→    } catch (error) {
   251→      normalizeAndPresentError(error, { context: 'TimelinePositions', showToast: false, logData: { operationId } });
   252→
   253→      if (rollback) {
   254→        rollback();
   255→      }
   256→
   257→      setStatus({
   258→        type: 'error',
   259→        message: (error as Error).message,
   260→        canRetry: true,
   261→      });

   263→      toast.error('Failed to update positions');

   275→        );
   276→      }, 50);
   277→    }

   289→    isLockedRef,

   291→  ]);
   292→
   293→  const addItemsAtPositions = useCallback((
   294→    items: Array<{ id: string; position: number }>,
   295→  ): (() => void) => {
   296→    return applyOptimistic(

   298→        id,
   299→        position,
   300→        operation: 'add' as const,
   301→      })),
   302→    );
   303→  }, [applyOptimistic]);
   304→
   305→  const removeItems = useCallback((ids: string[]): (() => void) => {
   306→    return applyOptimistic(
   307→      ids.map(id => ({
   308→        id,
   309→        position: 0,
   310→        operation: 'remove' as const,
   311→      })),
   312→    );
   313→  }, [applyOptimistic]);
   314→
   315→  /**
   316→   * Apply an optimistic visual update immediately, without entering the write
   317→   * queue or touching the DB.
   318→   */
   319→  const applyOptimisticPositionUpdate = useCallback((

   321→  ): (() => void) | null => {
   322→    const updates: Array<{ id: string; position: number; operation: 'add' | 'move' | 'remove' }> = [];
   323→    for (const [id, newPos] of newPositions) {
   324→      const oldPos = positionsRef.current.get(id);
   325→      if (oldPos !== newPos) {

   327→          id,
   328→          position: newPos,
   329→          operation: oldPos === undefined ? 'add' : 'move',
   330→        });
   331→      }
   332→    }
   333→    if (updates.length === 0) return null;
   334→    return applyOptimistic(updates);
   335→  }, [applyOptimistic, positionsRef]);
   336→
   337→  return {
   338→    updatePositions,
   339→    addItemsAtPositions,
   340→    removeItems,
   341→    applyOptimisticPositionUpdate,
   342→  };
   343→}

1→import { __WS_INSTRUMENTATION_ENABLED__, __CORRUPTION_TRACE_ENABLED__ } from '@/integrations/supabase/config/env';
     2→import { captureRealtimeSnapshot } from '@/integrations/supabase/utils/snapshot';
     3→import { __CORRUPTION_TIMELINE__, addCorruptionEvent } from '@/integrations/supabase/utils/timeline';
     4→import { normalizeAndReportError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandling/runtimeErrorReporting';
     5→import {
     6→  collectUnhandledRejectionInfo,
     7→  collectWindowErrorInfo,
     8→  isKnownSupabaseSourceLine,
     9→  isSupabaseRealtimeRelated,
    10→  parsePhoenixMessage,
    11→} from './eventCollectors';
    12→import {
    13→  installGlobalErrorPatchers,
    14→  installWebSocketProbe,
    15→  type InstrumentedWindow,
    16→} from './globalPatchers';
    17→
    18→function installCorruptionTracePatchers(instrumentedWindow: InstrumentedWindow): void {
    19→  installGlobalErrorPatchers({
    20→    instrumentedWindow,
    21→    onWindowError: (message, source, lineno, colno, error) => {
    22→      const errorInfo = collectWindowErrorInfo({
    23→        message,
    24→        source,
    25→        lineno,
    26→        colno,
    27→        error: error ?? null,
    28→      });
    29→
    30→      if (isKnownSupabaseSourceLine(source, lineno)) {
    31→        normalizeAndReportError(new Error('[RealtimeCorruptionTrace] Supabase error captured'), {
    32→          context: 'WindowInstrumentation',
    33→          showToast: false,
    34→          logData: {
    35→            ...errorInfo,
    36→            realtimeSnapshot: captureRealtimeSnapshot(),
    37→            corruptionTimeline: [...__CORRUPTION_TIMELINE__],
    38→          },
    39→        });
    40→        addCorruptionEvent('SUPABASE_ERROR_2372', errorInfo);
    41→      } else if (isSupabaseRealtimeRelated(message)) {
    42→        addCorruptionEvent('RELATED_ERROR', errorInfo);
    43→      }
    44→    },
    45→    onUnhandledRejection: (event) => {
    46→      const rejectionInfo = collectUnhandledRejectionInfo(event);
    47→      if (isSupabaseRealtimeRelated(event.reason)) {
    48→        addCorruptionEvent('UNHANDLED_REJECTION', rejectionInfo);
    49→      }
    50→    },
    51→  });
    52→}
    53→
    54→function installWebSocketInstrumentation(instrumentedWindow: InstrumentedWindow): void {
    55→  installWebSocketProbe({
    56→    instrumentedWindow,
    57→    onTrackedSocketMessage: ({ event }) => {
    58→      try {
    59→        const parsed = parsePhoenixMessage(event.data);
    60→        if (parsed) {
    61→          addCorruptionEvent('PHOENIX_MESSAGE', parsed);
    62→        }
    63→
    64→        const snapshot = instrumentedWindow.__REALTIME_SNAPSHOT__ || {};
    65→        instrumentedWindow.__REALTIME_SNAPSHOT__ = {
    66→          ...snapshot,
    67→          lastPhoenixMsgAt: Date.now(),
    68→        };
    69→      } catch {
    70→        // Ignore instrumentation parse failures so realtime flow remains unaffected.
    71→      }
    72→    },
    73→  });
    74→}
    75→
    76→export function installWindowOnlyInstrumentation() {
    77→  if (typeof window === 'undefined') {
    78→    return;
    79→  }
    80→
    81→  const instrumentedWindow = window as InstrumentedWindow;
    82→
    83→  if (__CORRUPTION_TRACE_ENABLED__) {
    84→    installCorruptionTracePatchers(instrumentedWindow);
    85→  }
    86→
    87→  if (__WS_INSTRUMENTATION_ENABLED__) {
    88→    installWebSocketInstrumentation(instrumentedWindow);
    89→  }
    90→}
    91→
